title: NBC 2016 core - dwelling requirements (seed)

review.notes: SEED PACK. Values were drafted from secondary summaries of NBC 2016 Part 3 (Development Control Rules and General Building Requirements) and Part 4 (Fire and Life Safety). Every value and every clause reference must be checked against the purchased BIS volumes before any pack in this chain leaves 'seed'.

disclaimer: Advisory only, not an approval. These checks are a drafting aid; the architect of record remains responsible for compliance. Values marked 'seed' were drafted by the Garh AI team from secondary sources and have not been verified against the published National Building Code.
notes: Root pack: dimensional requirements that every Indian city pack inherits. It contains NO setback, FAR, coverage, height or parking rules - those are municipal and live in the city packs. A nil requirement is encoded as NO rule; the absence of a rule means 'no minimum', never 'zero minimum'.

sources.label: SP 7 : 2016 National Building Code of India, Part 3 - Development Control Rules and General Building Requirements
SP 7 : 2016 National Building Code of India, Part 4 - Fire and Life Safety

rules.title: Habitable room - minimum area
rules.message: {element} is {actual} - a habitable room needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Enlarge the room to at least 9.50 m2, or reclassify it as a store/utility.
rules.notes: NBC states 9.5 m2 for a room in a dwelling with two or more habitable rooms; verify the single-room-tenement relaxation at review.

rules.title: Habitable room - minimum width
rules.message: {element} is only {actual} wide - a habitable room needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Widen the room to at least 2.40 m in its shorter direction.

rules.title: Kitchen - minimum area
rules.message: {element} is {actual} - a separate kitchen needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Enlarge the kitchen to at least 5.00 m2.

rules.title: Kitchen with dining - minimum area
rules.message: {element} combines cooking and dining, so it needs at least {limit} - it is {actual}.
rules.fix: Enlarge the kitchen-dining to at least 7.50 m2, or separate the dining area.

rules.title: Kitchen - minimum width
rules.message: {element} is only {actual} wide - a kitchen needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Widen the kitchen to at least 1.80 m so a counter plus circulation fits.

rules.title: Bathroom - minimum area
rules.message: {element} is {actual} - a bathroom needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Enlarge the bathroom to at least 1.80 m2.

rules.title: Bathroom - minimum width
rules.message: {element} is only {actual} wide - a bathroom needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Widen the bathroom to at least 1.20 m.

rules.title: Water closet - minimum area
rules.message: {element} is {actual} - a WC needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Enlarge the WC to at least 1.10 m2.

rules.title: Water closet - minimum width
rules.message: {element} is only {actual} wide - a WC needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Widen the WC to at least 0.90 m.
rules.notes: Not in the playbook seed list; added because a 1.10 m2 WC can otherwise be 0.5 m wide. Confirm the figure at review.

rules.title: Combined bath and WC - minimum area
rules.message: {element} combines bath and WC, so it needs at least {limit} - it is {actual}.
rules.fix: Enlarge the combined bath-WC to at least 2.80 m2.

rules.title: Habitable room - minimum ceiling height
rules.message: {element} has {actual} clear height - habitable rooms need at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Raise the floor-to-floor height so the clear height reaches 2.75 m.

rules.title: Kitchen - minimum ceiling height
rules.message: {element} has {actual} clear height - a kitchen needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Raise the clear height over the kitchen to 2.60 m.

rules.title: Bath / WC - minimum ceiling height
rules.message: {element} has {actual} clear height - a bath or WC needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Raise the clear height over the wet area to 2.20 m (watch the dropped ceiling for plumbing).

rules.title: Habitable room - light and ventilation
rules.message: {element} has {actual} of openable area - it needs at least {limit} (one tenth of its floor area).
rules.fix: Add or widen windows until the openable area reaches one tenth of the floor area.

rules.title: Kitchen - light and ventilation
rules.message: {element} has {actual} of openable area - a kitchen needs at least {limit} (one tenth of its floor area).
rules.fix: Add a window or ventilator over the counter until one tenth of the floor area is openable.

rules.title: Bath / WC - ventilation
rules.message: {element} has {actual} of openable area - a bath or WC needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Add a 0.30 m2 ventilator; an internal wet area needs one onto a shaft.

rules.title: Stair - maximum riser
rules.message: {element} has {actual} risers - the limit for a dwelling is {limit}.
rules.fix: Add a riser to the flight, or increase the flight length, so each riser is 190 mm or less.

rules.title: Stair - minimum tread
rules.message: {element} has {actual} treads - a dwelling stair needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Lengthen the flight so each tread is at least 250 mm.

rules.title: Stair - minimum width
rules.message: {element} is {actual} wide - a dwelling stair needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Widen the stair to at least 900 mm clear between handrails.

rules.title: Stair - minimum headroom
rules.message: {element} has {actual} of headroom - at least {limit} is needed above the nosing line.
rules.fix: Raise the landing slab or the storey height to clear 2.10 m above the nosing line.

rules.title: Main entrance door - minimum width
rules.message: The main door is {actual} wide - it needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Widen the main entrance door to at least 900 mm.

rules.title: Internal door - minimum width
rules.message: {element} is {actual} wide - an internal door needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Widen the door to at least 800 mm.

rules.title: Bath / WC door - minimum width
rules.message: {element} is {actual} wide - a bath or WC door needs at least {limit}.
rules.fix: Widen the door to at least 750 mm.
